Slot-less iteration experiments (48 vs 96) are permitted conditions; jm_27 and ok-35 parameterSymbols correctly use runtime slotName values (parameter1, function1, multiplier, thresholdOffset, firstMap, secondMap). Profile centers/zooms/iterations match each pinned profile. Feature iteration: "ok-35 maps z with firstMap before comparing product and quotient magnitudes" — accurate (loop/1 product, loop/2 quotient, loop/3 if |product| <= |quotient|).

Formula 10: fzppcoct (028a6158). Source: init z = pixel; offset = cosxx(pixel)/sin(pixel). loop/0: z = cosxx(z) + offset. bailout |z| <= 50. Candidate matches.
